text:
Sam: FYI RegulaTech just asked for a private deployment (VPC + on-prem data plane) — strict compliance window. Can product triage?
Anya: Thanks. Quick Q — target go-live and absolute must-haves?
Sam: They want end of Q3 (~12 weeks). Musts: customer-managed KMS, offline/off-airgap installer option, on-prem HSM support (optional), SLA 99.9, ability to pin model versions, and per-route telemetry.
Anya: Okay. Lia / Juan — can you surface blockers and rough effort?
Lia: Main gaps: our installer lacks a documented offline flow for HA. No automated KMS rotation on the private bundle. Need clear egress/ingress port doc for their security team.
Juan: Additions: hardware compatibility list (NICs, GPUs), SCAP/OS hardening checklist, and procurement lead time for HSMs. HSM integration may need PKCS#11 work depending on vendor.
Matt: How about support during cutover? They requested 24/7 SE coverage for the two-week migration window.
Anya: Proposed launch criteria to include 1) Successful install in customer staging network, 2) Perf gates: p95 inference under 120ms on their test set, 3) Security signoff (external audit or checklist), 4) Runbook + oncall rota, 5) Canary traffic for 72h with no P1s.
Sam: Customer is willing to pay for 2 weeks dedicated onboarding SE + travel if needed. They prefer a canary-first rollout, then full switch.
Lia: Timeline note: offline installer + HSM baseline + docs = ~6–8 weeks. Security/compliance signoff and test cycles = additional 4 weeks if parallelized. Realistic: 10–12 weeks, but we need 2 FTE infra + 1 SE dedicated.
Anya: Prioritization: mark as "enterprise private" and push to top of private queue given ARR and legal constraints. I'll open intake ticket and add a canary milestone.
Juan: I'll spin up an internal POC this week to validate offline installer and PKCS#11 hooks. Lia, can we pair on a minimal runbook draft after that?
Lia: Yes — sync tomorrow 10am PT. @Sam please drop their network diagrams and HSM vendor/model. Also need their expected RTO/RPO.
Sam: Uploading diagrams now. Link to security requirements: https://drive.redwood/regulatech-sec.pdf. RTO target is 15m, RPO zero for sensitive data.
deploy-bot: New intake ticket created: INC-4321 assigned to eng-private.
Anya: Nice. I'll add the launch criteria and preliminary estimates to INC-4321. Next check-in after Juan's POC — aim for EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
Juan: Roger. Will report POC notes + blocking items in the ticket.
Matt: I'll add the support rota template and escalation matrix to INC-4321.
Anya: Thanks everyone — keeping this high priority.
metadata_notes: intake thread for customer RegulaTech private/on-prem feasibility, includes launch criteria, blockers, timeline estimate, and next steps
